photos.c: Gary Staines, fresh from his Olympic 5000m final spearheaded a fine Belgrave team effort in the first Surrey C.C.League Match. Gary (21), Jean Paul Wright (8), followed by Mark Sinclair, Matthew Stickles, Mike Hayes (20), Francis Ward, Marcello Bizio (15) and Ollie Foote (11).
